notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Here is a [b]short[/b] overview of what we have fixed and improved in the last few days:

[list]
[*] Storage Boxes [b]FIXED & IMPROVED[/b]
[*] Weird storage box sound effect that played randomly [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Flashlight [b]FIXED & IMPROVED[/b]
[*] The Phone [b]FIXED & IMPROVED[/b]: 
    [list][*][i]We designed a new animated model, it's now more of a multimedia monitor than a phone. 
    [*]New display screens and also some new functions. 
    [*]Pandas Kitchen no longer repeats itself if you call several times, then something else comes up.[/i][/list][*] Subtitles [b]ADDED[/b] to every conversation (different colors for each actor)
[*] Not available in the demo text [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Tablet usage [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Timer from one conversation to another [b]IMPROVED[/b]: The waiting times are now reduced from 180 seconds to 90 seconds
[*] Jukebox [b]FIXED & IMPROVED[/b] We've added Surround Sound to it, the sound comes now directly from the jukebox, also conversations are very good audible if the   Jukebox is playing music.
[*] Food-O-Matic App [b]ADDED[/b]
[*] Food-O-Matic Machine [b]ADDED[/b]
[*] Weird Can't move anymore (Alt key to move again) [b]FIXED[/b]
[*] Main Menu, Pause Menu fully new design and improvements (Background Sound and Loadingscreens too)
[*] Lot of performance optimizations
[/list]
